event.name: event
event.description:
Tagged-primary-v11. Emit this scalar string for EVERY latest reply, including unknown. Current phase {{phase}}, calendar {{now}}, called person {{title}} {{first_name}} {{last_name}}. Current speech only, no cached facts. Output tagged rows only, no JSON or sibling fields.
Grammar: k=KIND;c=0_OR_1;optional KEY=VALUE;END. Multiple rows separated by one actual newline, no trailing newline. Required k,c. Keys: p product ID/type/label; a complete positive decimal, at most two fractional digits; d complete verbatim date; v complete requested security answer; t HH:MM; u unfinished component amount/date/both/unknown. No empty, duplicate or unknown keys. Value alphabet: ASCII letters/digits/spaces/underscore/comma/period/slash/colon/hyphen. No escaping; unrepresentable input is unknown. c=1 is complete current positive assertion, excluding quoted/hypothetical/negated/third-party facts. c=0 is unfinished; payment corrections require u, retaining only independently completed a/d. Complete rows omit u.
Date grammar: ISO, day/month/year, today/tomorrow, this/next weekday, month words/ordinals with optional year, weekday plus ordinal, or day-only ordinal referring to the current offer. Preserve wording. Next weekday means following calendar week; this means current week. Numeric DOB means day/month/year; year mandatory.
Literal examples and complete kind set:
k=recipient;c=1;END
k=third_party;c=1;END
k=wrong_number;c=1;END
k=deceased;c=1;END
k=security;c=1;v=14 October 1980;END
k=security;c=1;v=0123;END
k=decline;c=1;END
k=purpose;c=1;END
k=agree;c=1;END
k=confirm;c=1;END
k=proposal;c=1;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=refuse;c=1;END
k=too_much;c=1;END
k=vague;c=1;END
k=paid;c=1;END
k=dispute;c=1;END
k=hardship;c=1;END
k=plan;c=1;END
k=human;c=1;END
k=stop;c=1;END
k=callback;c=1;d=tomorrow;t=15:00;END
k=unknown;c=1;END
k=question;c=1;END
k=change;c=0;u=date;a=120;END
k=proposal;c=1;a=120;END
k=proposal;c=1;d=November second;END
k=proposal;c=0;u=amount;d=this Friday;END
k=security;c=0;END
Recipient: yes/thats me/speaking/current own name, including benign greetings, optional matching supplied title, supplied title plus surname, or comma-inverted surname/given name, is recipient only; conflicting explicit given names/titles, quoted, negative, conditional and third-party names are unknown; generic confirm valid here. Hello alone unknown. Security: v canonical YYYY-MM-DD for DOB, exactly four digits for phone. Preserve leading zero. Introductory words excluded. Explicit phone groups concatenate losslessly: fifteen zero two -> 1502; twenty one zero three -> 2103. Never pad digits or year. Complete self-answer plus any independent question/neutral aside stays security. Missing year/digits is c=0. Questions cannot supply operands; unresolved alternatives require clarification.
Offer yes -> agree to spoken offer, never write consent. Readback yes -> fresh confirm for current terms only. Changed amount/date -> proposal; qualified/withdrawn permission -> change, never confirm. Yes no problem is affirmative. Amount/date alone -> proposal, never refusal. Vague period -> vague. Current arrears already paid -> paid; historical closed/paid off -> dispute. Hardship outranks plan/refusal, retaining voluntary a/d. Lower instalments/new plan -> plan; actual human request -> human; AI enquiry -> question. Relative offering payment -> third_party. Support-phase no -> decline. Independent questions do not erase primary facts. Separate complete amount/date rows may complete one target; never copy old terms as new facts. Raw source is mandatory for security agreement; no financial permission from raw.
Security subject: my modifies the requested DOB/phone field only; my sister/brother/partner/neighbour or a named person is third-party, never self. Bare complete answers bind only to the current question. Paid: current completed self claims include I actually paid it in the app, I made the payment through the app, I processed the payment through the app. In this single verified product call, it/the payment can refer to the currently spoken debt. Future, negative, quoted, hypothetical, third-party, unrelated purchase, historical payoff and unfinished claims are not paid.

Completed first-person contractions such as Ive/I have and I have made or processed the payment retain paid meaning only for the current arrears. Confirmation is a present unquoted self act answering the current readback, never reported or attributed permission or another operation. Phone labels may say the last four digits of my phone number or my phone number ends in; retain the exact complete operand, never another persons answer.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: Exact latest user utterance, once and verbatim. Always emit this string; never earlier history or an object.

admin.name: admin
admin.description: Only independent administrative question acts in the latest utterance: none, ai, scam, purpose, balance, security_purpose, relative_policy, other; space separated if several. Emit none when absent. Security-purpose means why security answers are needed; purpose means why calling; balance means an account balance or amount owed question. Preserve questions accompanying a complete or unfinished primary answer, regardless of comma, semicolon or and. Output only these flags. Use other for an independent question not covered by named flags. A complete self-answer and any independent question are concurrent acts; preserve the answer regardless of question wording. Never put question digits into the requested security answer.
